summary: Avalo Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering includes shares and pre-funded warrants exercisable at $0.001 below the public price, with an ownership limitation of 4.99% or 9.99%. The last reported sale price on May 4, 2026, was $13.78 per share. Underwriters include Leerink Partners, TD Cowen, and BofA Securities, with a 30-day greenshoe option. This capital-raising event is not a special situation; it is a routine equity shelf takedown. The filing does not indicate a strategic review or M&A event.
